hypothesis: The compiler frequently edits grids, but reads only a fraction of their cells. Register each line in its original raster cells, then cache the canonical ordered nearby-line query only where points read it. Preserve all arithmetic, ordering, duplicates and charged work.

largerBudgetGuard.purpose: standalone regression guard, not a separately confirmed speedup claim

protocol.adoption: Require engine and 150k automatic fresh confirmations, no credible regression in standalone 750k check, exact full structural gates. Disclose post-registration stepping tradeoff.

machine.build: locked cargo release, wasm32-unknown-unknown, plain Rust 1.95.0 in both arms; no wasm-opt
machine.isolation: Measurements sequential on CPU 2, without concurrent builds, tests or parity. Normal desktop background processes remained. Same-host A/A control is preserved in engine-promotion-20261103.json.

profile.scope: Baseline automatic cell 61; one warmup and two measured compiles. CPU profile includes startup and worker bookkeeping. Built with strip=false for function names; not used for A/B timing.

development.original_cells: Passed engine/automatic screens but branch workload regressed; refined before confirmation.
development.compact_cells: Skipped empty neighboring buckets; isolated stepping remained slower.
development.flat_cells: A separate flat list per point repeatedly rebuilt neighborhoods; isolated stepping was slower.
development.shared_flat_cells: Shared flat lists reduced rebuilding, but every point still checked the shared table.
development.two_level_cells: Frozen final candidate combines shared neighborhood lists with retained point queries. Formal confirmation and the larger-budget guard decide adoption.

memoryDiagnostic.description: WASM linear-memory high-water size after each complete workload in a fresh instance; not live allocations or process RSS.

manifest.note: Computed-cache copies and collision observations only. Cached contact positions are read without stepping or replay. Final judging uses the unchanged benchmark engine.

accepted.decision: Keep for the compiler backend after fresh engine and automatic confirmations, a standalone larger-budget regression check and exact structural gates. Disclose the isolated stepping cost; this is not a universal solver-speed claim.

limitations: Bootstrap support is not a posterior or an anytime-valid stopping rule.
The warmed 150k automatic case has fresh confirmation. The 750k case is a fixed standalone regression guard, not an independently confirmed speedup claim.
The engine panel includes registration. The post-registration diagnostic deliberately measures the remaining stepping tradeoff separately.
These are fixed-workload, same-machine measurements, not evidence across unseen songs or hardware.
